description: This file is a PHP web page that provides a user interface for editing a device entry in a parental control managed devices list. It includes server-side PHP code for retrieving device data, and client-side HTML, JavaScript, and jQuery code for rendering and managing the form, validation, and AJAX submission.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the form with device data, sets up the UI elements, and defines event handlers for form actions.

methods.name: updateAllowTimeVisibility
methods.description: Enables or disables the allow time selection controls based on whether the device is set to always allow.
